params.formula:
CASE 
        WHEN node_type = 'STATION' THEN 
            CASE 
                WHEN rootpoints = 1 THEN 'STATION USED'
                ELSE 'STATION NOT USED'
            END
            
        WHEN node_type = 'CLIENT' THEN 
            CASE 
                WHEN node = 1 THEN 'CLIENT REACHED'
                ELSE 'CLIENT NOT REACHED'
END
            
        WHEN node = 1 THEN 'PIPING'
        
        ELSE 'NOTHING'
    END
